items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Because I used to get all my friends on the gigs, you know J.R. [Monterose] played them

ctx.x: Because I used to get all my friends on the gigs, you know J.R. [Monterose] played them and it was hilarious times. And Foster Brooks was the act. You remember Foster Brooks with his drunk act and all that. So it was on a Sunday and I went with Jill and Ricky. I took them along to the gig. And we were there a little early and the crowd was already there and Dominick decided let’s go on now, but the band hadn’t showed up yet. So I had to play Foster Brooks on. So I just said “Ricky, come up and play, we’ll just…

had a wedding band in the eighties I mean he could come up and play the whole gig with us and sometimes he would. And you would never notice, there was never — okay we’re playing with a kid who doesn’t know, we’ve got to make concessions. It was never that. He just played the gig. So he got a lot of experience early on.
